Variants.Content: Vassal councils brought together scattered lords to discuss taxes, wars, inheritances, and common threats. It may not have a fixed legal form, but it can form a strong consensus. If the king can hear different voices, his rule will be more stable. If he only listens to those who agree, the crisis will come more suddenly.

Entry Council of Vassals Vassal councils brought together scattered lords to discuss taxes, wars, inheritances, and common threats. It may not have a fixed legal form, but it can form a strong consensus. If the king can hear different voices, his rule will be more stable. If he only listens to those who agree, the crisis will come more suddenly. They start by asking who is obligated, who is protected, and who will seek justice after a breach of contract.
